senses.zh_definition: 杰里：人名 Jerry 的常见中文音译；在马来语句子中通常作为专有名词使用。
senses.en_definition: Jerry, a personal name used as a proper noun.
senses.ms_definition: Nama orang yang dieja Jerry dan ditulis dengan huruf awal besar.
senses.nuances: 此处 noun 表示 kata nama khas，即专有名词。输入包没有 DBP 释义或语境，不能据此认证为官方马来语普通词，也不能确定所指人物；因此保留待核实状态。释义及例句为专名用法说明，例句人物为虚构人物。下列组合是称谓和句法示例，不是经频率验证的固定搭配。所列英语读音参考 [Cambridge 发音资料](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/pronunciation/english/jerry)。

etymology.historical_story: A personal name can appear repeatedly in Malay conversations without becoming a Malay common word. Jerry should therefore retain its identity as a name rather than receive an invented Malay root. The packet supplies no bearer or naming history, so its particular origin and any relationship to a longer name remain unverified.
